quest: XSP Freshness and Pressure On-ramp outcome-blind multiscale atlas

source.formation: exactly 60 contiguous, content-addressed, eligible, valid, standard-L1 RTH seconds ending at the crowned signal-bar close

hypothesis: The topology of SPY cash discovery, leverage-normalized UPRO/inverse-SPXU transport response, liquidity pressure, volatility/volume acceleration, and existing slower XSP context may distinguish authentic fresh pressure, cresting pressure, cross-book refusal, and reconvergence without changing the crowned direction.

seconds_clocks.price_law: For each horizon h and each direction-normalized book, slope(t,h)=10000*(log(mid_t)-log(mid_t-h))/h. Velocity change, acceleration, and jerk are the first, second, and third one-second finite differences of that rolling slope.
seconds_clocks.flow_law: For true range, cumulative-volume delta, valid quote updates, spread, imbalance, and same-price size pressure, use the rolling h-second mean and its first, second, and third one-second finite differences.
seconds_clocks.inverse_law: SPXU price, imbalance, and same-price size pressure are sign-inverted into market direction; unsigned range, volume, quote intensity, and spread are not inverted.
seconds_clocks.transport_law: UPRO and inverse-SPXU returns are each divided by their known 3x exposure before averaging; basis is SPY cash slope minus that scaled transport slope.
seconds_clocks.basis_law: A sign crossing is CROSSING; otherwise falling absolute basis displacement is RECONVERGING, rising absolute displacement is DIVERGING, and equality is STABLE.
